build_mobilenetv2_backbone: build a MobileNetV2 backbone model with configurable widen_factor and out_indices for pose estimation
create_invertedresidual_block: create an InvertedResidual block with expand_ratio, stride, and optional gradient checkpointing
test_mobilenetv2_forward: test the MobileNetV2 forward pass by passing an input tensor and collecting stage outputs
freeze_mobilenetv2_stages: freeze selected stages of the MobileNetV2 backbone to prevent gradient updates during training
review_invertedresidual_forward: review the InvertedResidual forward method including residual connection and checkpoint logic
